object: fluorinated diamond-like carbon hydrophobic condenser coatings
problem: Can a durable hydrophobic coating sustain dropwise condensation for years in steam power plant condensers?
mechanism_or_method: Multilayer pinhole-free F-DLC deposition with tailored substrate adhesion giving low surface energy and metal-like modulus.
limitation: Lab steam condensation test only; scale-up and cost of coating deposition on industrial condensers unproven.
decision_relevance: Supports coating choice for power plant condenser surfaces.

object: elastomer-based tough hydrogel for artificial skin
problem: How to make a hydrogel with skin-like modulus, friction and load capacity for bionic robot skin?
mechanism_or_method: Radiation-induced penetrating polymerization grafts hydrophilic chains onto elastomer networks, mimicking collagen fibers in water-rich matrix.
limitation: Only lab mechanical and friction tests; long-term durability and hydration stability not shown.

object: interfacial solar evaporators and vaporization enthalpy measurement
problem: Is dark-environment evaporation testing valid for claiming reduced water vaporization enthalpy in solar evaporators?
mechanism_or_method: Theory and experiments showing evaporative cooling alters environmental energy input, explaining rate differences without enthalpy reduction.
limitation: Does not rule out all possible enthalpy-reduction mechanisms under other conditions.
decision_relevance: Changes how evaporator performance and enthalpy claims should be characterized.

object: triboelectric self-powered sensing platform for underground mines
problem: Can battery-free TENG modules power wireless wind and gas sensing in underground mines?
mechanism_or_method: Non-contact TENG wind turbine for sensing plus hybrid-mode TENG array with power management, powering sensor node and LoRa transmitter.
limitation: Low harvested power density; operation demonstrated for about 3 months in limited mine tunnels.
decision_relevance: Informs battery-free sensor power design for ventilation monitoring in mines.

object: water-washable ceramic catalyst air filters
problem: Can a regenerable filter remove PM and VOCs simultaneously with long lifetime?
mechanism_or_method: Ceramic filter channels coated with inorganic membrane (inner) and Cu2O/TiO2 photocatalyst (outer), regenerated by water washing.
limitation: 20-year lifetime is extrapolated from ten regeneration cycles, not directly measured.
decision_relevance: Favors regenerable ceramic filters over disposable filters for air purification.

object: chemically fixed bovine pericardium for heart valve leaflets
problem: Why is bovine pericardium fatigue resistance insensitive to flaws such as suture holes?
mechanism_or_method: Cyclic stretch tests with cuts; strong collagen fibers in soft matrix transmit tension over long lengths and dissipate energy upon breakage.
limitation: Single tissue type and TPU comparison; in vivo conditions and calcification not addressed.
decision_relevance: Guides leaflet material choice and design for flaw-tolerant fatigue resistance.

object: battery-grade lithium precursor purity
problem: Does lower-purity lithium with Mg impurity harm cathode performance and can it cut cost and emissions?
mechanism_or_method: Cathode synthesis with 1% Mg-containing lithium precursor, plus industrial-scale cost and CO2 assessment.
limitation: Only Mg impurity studied; industrial savings are modeled estimates rather than plant data.

object: high-entropy alloy nanoparticles via thermal plasma
problem: Can HEA nanoparticles be synthesized continuously and scalably from elemental metal powders?
mechanism_or_method: In-flight alloying in a thermal plasma jet with rapid heating and cooling, supported by thermofluid simulation.
limitation: Conversion efficiency only 42%; only one alloy composition demonstrated.

object: polyelectrolyte artificial spider silk fibers
problem: How to achieve spider-silk-like strength and toughness in artificial fibers?
mechanism_or_method: Ion-controlled chain dissociation and evaporation-induced self-assembly under stress to form superfine nanofibrils.
limitation: Strength-toughness trade-off remains; small-scale lab spinning only.

object: crown-ether polymer nanofilm membranes for organic solvent separation
problem: Can crosslinked crown ether nanofilms give higher selectivity for pharmaceutical separations in organic solvents?
mechanism_or_method: Interfacial polymerization of fully crosslinked crown ethers into 24 nm films on porous supports.
limitation: Tested on model mixtures; long-term stability and scale-up not demonstrated.

object: supercapacitor electrodes for electrochemical CO2 capture
problem: How do electrode structure and charging protocol affect supercapacitor CO2 capture performance?
mechanism_or_method: Structure-property-performance correlations across activated carbons under varied charging protocols, including positive charging mode.
limitation: Lab-scale cell tests; real flue gas contaminants and scale-up not addressed.

object: self-powered visualized tactile-acoustic sensor
problem: Can a self-powered sensor give visualized tactile and acoustic perception with high sensitivity?
mechanism_or_method: Triboelectrification-induced electroluminescence unit converting sliding and sound into light signals.
limitation: Lab demonstrations only; brightness modest and robustness under real use unproven.

object: Dyson sphere-like solar evaporators
problem: Can self-generated internal convection raise interfacial solar evaporation rates without external power?
mechanism_or_method: Spherical evaporator geometry that drives internal airflow, trading 36% of light energy for vapor removal.
limitation: Indoor simulated-sun tests; outdoor performance and salt fouling not reported.
decision_relevance: Suggests evaporator design should allocate energy between evaporation and vapor-removing convection.

object: configuration-editable tough aramid-PVA aerogels
problem: How to make lightweight aerogels both tough and shape-editable?
mechanism_or_method: Twice-coagulated strategy: flexible PVA network first, then ANF network locks the edited configuration.
limitation: Proof of concept with one material pair; scalability not shown.

object: soft textile robots made by encoded sewing
problem: How to build programmable 3D soft textile robots through a simple 2D sewing process?
mechanism_or_method: Encoding heterogeneous stretching constraints into seams so bladder inflation follows prescribed shape and actuation sequence.
limitation: Textile durability and precision of programmed motions under repeated cycling not detailed.
decision_relevance: Guides low-cost design of pneumatic soft robot shells.

object: knitted fabrics mechanics
problem: How does stitch topology determine the emergent elasticity of knitted fabrics?
mechanism_or_method: Experiments and simulation to build a constitutive model for nonlinear bulk response, enabling composite fabrics independent of yarn.
limitation: Limited to several stitch types; model validated on lab-scale fabrics.
decision_relevance: Lets designers specify fabric stiffness by stitch pattern.

object: mechanical metamaterials for cascaded logic computing
problem: How can solitary waves compute multi-level cascaded logic in mechanical metamaterials without dissipation?
mechanism_or_method: Bistable chain units with heterogeneous design and an energy-potential analytical framework to control soliton profile and logic elements.
limitation: Prototype-scale logic circuits; speed and reconfigurability limited.

object: melt-quenched porous MOF glasses from ZIF-8
problem: How to obtain highly porous MOF liquids and glasses from a non-meltable MOF?
mechanism_or_method: Solvent-assisted linker exchange introduces two extra linkers into ZIF-8, creating high-entropy derivatives that melt and vitrify.
limitation: Pore volume of glasses still modest, about 0.2 cm3 per g.

object: Ni2CoFeV medium-entropy alloy
problem: How to obtain ultrahigh strength with good ductility in medium-entropy alloys?
mechanism_or_method: Hierarchical ordering introducing kappa and L12 intermetallic phases in fcc matrix, activating multiple slip and stacking faults.
limitation: Room-temperature tensile only; fatigue, creep and processing scalability not evaluated.
decision_relevance: Guides alloy design for strength-ductility structural materials.

object: Pd-doped hierarchical H-ZSM-5 catalyst
problem: Can spatial segregation of Pd and acid sites improve fatty acid hydrodeoxygenation selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Pd nanoparticles deposited only in mesopores while acidity stays in micropores of hierarchical ZSM-5.
limitation: Single model fatty acid; catalyst lifetime and real feedstocks not shown.

object: hygromorphic 4D-printed cellulose adaptive shading
problem: Can biobased 4D-printed bilayers provide weather-responsive shading in real building facades?
mechanism_or_method: Cellulosic hygromorphic bilayers responding to temperature and humidity, tested in lab, year-long weather exposure, and facade deployment.
limitation: Response speed and long-term durability beyond a year are not established.
decision_relevance: Supports passive hygromorphic shading as facade alternative to powered systems.

object: TAMOF-1 metal-organic framework for CO2/CH4 separation
problem: Is TAMOF-1 an effective, stable adsorbent for CO2 purification from biogas and how does it bind CO2?
mechanism_or_method: Adsorption measurements with IAST selectivity plus neutron diffraction, spectroscopy and theory revealing dual-site weak binding.
limitation: Model biogas streams only; no real biogas or process-scale testing.

object: self-bridging mechanical metamaterials
problem: Can metamaterials realize Poisson's ratios beyond thermodynamic limits of linear materials?
mechanism_or_method: Self-contact bridging of slits yields multi-mode microscale levers breaking symmetry and static reciprocity, producing non-reciprocal and extreme Poisson's ratios.
limitation: Relies on contact nonlinearity; behavior under repeated cycling and scaling not discussed.

object: direct-current triboelectric nanogenerators
problem: How to suppress side-discharge and raise Coulombic efficiency in triboelectric nanogenerators?
mechanism_or_method: Spontaneously established reverse electric field between electrode and triboelectric layer restricts side-discharge.
limitation: Bench-scale devices; long-term durability and wear not reported.

object: self-healable perovskite-elastomer gas-solid triboelectric nanogenerator
problem: How to raise output of gas-solid TENGs for gesture and gripper sensing?
mechanism_or_method: Porous self-healing PSDU elastomer with ferroelectric (DF-CBA)2CuCl4 fillers and electric poling to enhance charge accumulation.
limitation: Lab demonstrations; stability of ferroelectric filler and output under humidity not detailed.

object: laser powder bed fusion Ti-6Al-4V process parameters
problem: How to efficiently find process and heat-treatment parameters giving both high strength and ductility?
mechanism_or_method: Pareto active learning over 296 candidates with targeted experimental validation.
limitation: Limited to one alloy and machine; transfer to other systems unverified.
decision_relevance: Selects LPBF and heat-treatment settings for Ti-6Al-4V parts.

object: 3D-printed fouling-resistant self-floating solar evaporator
problem: Can a concave 3D-printed evaporator sustain efficient desalination without salt fouling over long periods?
mechanism_or_method: Bottom-surface evaporation with decoupled absorber, double-sided surface modification, and floating collector using seawater cooling.
limitation: Tested under simulated one-sun; real marine conditions and scale not fully shown.

object: self-adaptive sprayable radiative thermal management coatings
problem: Can a coating autonomously switch between cooling and heating modes over large areas without stimuli?
mechanism_or_method: Micro-heterostructure coating with chromogenic molecules whose conjugation forms and breaks with temperature, modulating visible light and scattering sunlight.
limitation: Outdoor durability and cycling stability of chromogenic molecules not established.

object: WS2/Pt catalysts for coupled electrosynthesis and hydrogen production
problem: Can replacing oxygen evolution with azofurazan electrosynthesis lower hydrogen production energy?
mechanism_or_method: Anodic oxidative coupling producing DAAF energetic material coupled to hydrogen evolution on WS2/Pt, with DFT for mechanism.
limitation: Lab electrolyzer only; Pt catalyst cost and product handling hazards remain.

object: dynamic porous crystal with temperature-switchable gas selectivity
problem: Can host-guest selectivity for CO2 and C2H2 be switched by temperature?
mechanism_or_method: Diffusion regulation by flip-flop organic moieties in ultrasmall pore apertures amplifies rate differences between gases.
limitation: Single-component adsorption emphasis; mixed-gas process performance and stability limited.

object: selenium-functionalized polyphenylene sulfide fabric for mercury capture
problem: Can a biomimetic sulfur-selenium pair immobilize elemental mercury at record capacity and rate?
mechanism_or_method: PPS weakly adsorbs Hg0 and transports it to adjacent selenium sites forming HgSe permanently.
limitation: Lab adsorption tests; performance in real flue gas conditions not shown.

object: MOF nanotrap for rare earth element separation
problem: Can a single MOF step separate individual rare earth elements with high selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Two-fold interpenetrated MOF NCU-1 with dense carboxyl and triazole sites and tuned pore size responding to ionic radius.
limitation: Binary-pair model separations; multicomponent performance and cycling for real tailings limited.

object: water-resistant high-entropy spinel oxide catalysts
problem: Can raising configurational entropy make oxide catalysts resist water deactivation in propene oxidation?
mechanism_or_method: DFT screening of adsorption and vacancy energies then synthesis of (NiMgCuZnCo)Cr2O4 with in-situ spectroscopy confirming low water adsorption.
limitation: One reaction and spinel family; stability tested only about 100 hours.

object: skin-attached dielectric elastomer actuator haptic patch
problem: Can a thin soft actuator array deliver adjustable large forces for wearable tactile interaction?
mechanism_or_method: Flat cone dielectric elastomer actuator array integrated with photomicrosensor array for wireless haptic communication.
limitation: Requires high drive voltages and small user demonstrations; long-term skin comfort unstudied.

object: columnar to equiaxed transition in additively manufactured Ti alloys
problem: Which compositional parameter best predicts columnar-to-equiaxed transition in metal additive manufacturing?
mechanism_or_method: Compare solidification range, growth restriction factor and constitutional supercooling parameter using DED Ti alloys and CET models.
limitation: Verified mostly on Ti alloys; other systems checked only by literature reconsideration.
decision_relevance: Guides alloying element selection to avoid columnar grains in AM.

object: beta-cyclodextrin supramolecular polymerization for gold recovery
problem: Can additive-induced cocrystallization recover gold from dilute solutions with high efficiency and selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Additives co-occupy cyclodextrin cavity with tetrabromoaurate, triggering supramolecular polymer assembly and precipitation.
limitation: Laboratory-scale e-waste recovery only; reagent cost and scale-up unproven.

object: graphite flake on nanostructured silicon structural superlubricity
problem: Can robust structural superlubricity be achieved in ambient conditions despite graphite edge defects and rough surfaces?
mechanism_or_method: Edge warping of graphite flake on nanostructured silicon under concentrated force removes edge interaction with substrate.
limitation: Microscale flakes only; scaling to large-area contacts and varied materials unverified.
decision_relevance: Relaxes surface roughness requirements for superlubric contacts in ambient conditions.

object: polymer membranes for complex organic mixture separation
problem: Can organic mixture permeation through arbitrary polymer membranes be predicted from composition and chemistry?
mechanism_or_method: Physics-informed machine learning predictors of diffusion and sorption coupled with mass transport simulators for up to 400 components.
limitation: Validated on two crude oils and linear polymers only.

object: multistage coupling water-enabled electric generator
problem: How to harvest both liquid flow and subsequent moisture energy in one generator with customizable output?
mechanism_or_method: Distributary water design integrating flow-enabled and moisture-diffusion layers as modular building blocks connectable in series.
limitation: Low power density of about 92 mW per m2; long-term stability unreported.

object: laser-driven gas-needle micro-transfer printing
problem: How to transfer microchips with both high selectivity and high accuracy?
mechanism_or_method: UV laser forms embedded carbon-gas layer, infrared laser expands hierarchical gas-needles for approach-and-release adhesion modulation.
limitation: Demonstrated on lab laser setup and micro-LED arrays; throughput at production scale not shown.
decision_relevance: Offers a contactless transfer-printing option for micro-LED assembly.

object: CoCrFeNi high-entropy alloy nanopillars
problem: Why do single-crystal HEA nanopillars show room-temperature super-elongation without premature necking?
mechanism_or_method: In-situ microscopy and atomistic simulations reveal coordinated twinning and dislocation slip arising from atomic-scale chemical heterogeneity.
limitation: Nanoscale pillars only; relevance to bulk alloy ductility unclear.

object: self-driving vehicle legal driving behavior monitor
problem: How to monitor traffic-law compliance of self-driving vehicles online despite ambiguous legal thresholds?
mechanism_or_method: Trigger-based hierarchical online monitor with compliance thresholds derived from real human driving behavior.
limitation: Thresholds based on Chinese driving data; generalization to other regions and laws uncertain.
decision_relevance: Informs compliance checking design for autonomous vehicle regulation.

object: soft fluidic actuators and grippers
problem: Can soft pneumatic actuators sense interactions without embedded sensors or design changes?
mechanism_or_method: Measure fluidic input needed to actuate and relate it to deformed state, enabling tactile sensing and closed-loop gripping.
limitation: Needs interaction to change internal volume; sensing resolution depends on fluid compressibility and actuator hysteresis.
decision_relevance: Allows adding sensing to existing soft actuators without redesign.

object: plasma-assisted PVDF multifunctional membranes
problem: Can plasma-assisted phase separation make superhydrophobic, self-cleaning, piezoelectric membranes without post-treatment?
mechanism_or_method: Plasma-assisted nonsolvent induced phase separation of PVDF forming rough hydrophobic piezoelectric structure.
limitation: Lab-scale membranes; long-term fouling and wetting resistance in distillation not established.

object: flexible calorimetric flow sensor for micro air vehicles
problem: Can a single sensor estimate angle of attack, sideslip and airflow velocity with high resolution?
mechanism_or_method: Suspended array of vanadium oxide thermistors in flexible calorimetric structure sensing relative airflow direction and speed.
limitation: Wing-model tests in controlled airflow; in-flight performance and robustness not shown.

object: hydrazide-functionalized star polymer for precious metal recovery
problem: Can a reducing star-shaped polymer recover gold, palladium and platinum with high capacity and selectivity?
mechanism_or_method: Hydrazide groups reduce metal ions while compact star chain forms large collectable precipitates via chemisorption.
limitation: Lab-scale batch tests; polymer synthesis cost and scale-up not addressed.

object: microporous polyamide nanofilm membranes
problem: How to tune microporosity by interfacial polymerization for ultrafast molecular separation?
mechanism_or_method: Dual-phase approach pairing Troger's base diamine and spirobifluorene to form highly porous ultrathin polyamide films.
limitation: Lab-scale films; long-term stability and module-scale production not shown.

object: adsorption-based direct air capture with water harvesting
problem: Can co-harvesting water and CO2 cut regeneration energy for distributed direct air capture?
mechanism_or_method: In-situ water-vapor purge at about 100 C enhances CO2 desorption, producing pure CO2 and fresh water; solar-powered prototype.
limitation: Prototype-scale tests; outdoor long-term operation and economics not assessed.
decision_relevance: Favors vapor-purge regeneration design for low-cost distributed DAC units.

object: velvet worm-inspired magnetorheological adhesive soft robot
problem: How to achieve delicate controllable adhesion on wrinkled soft surfaces with low preload?
mechanism_or_method: Structured magnetorheological material changes stiffness under external magnetic field to control adhesion and contact area.
limitation: Demonstrated on ex vivo and mouse models; clinical safety and field strength requirements unaddressed.

object: direct-current triboelectric nanogenerator discharge domains
problem: What discharge domains govern the dynamics and output of DC triboelectric nanogenerators beyond the capacitor-breakdown model?
mechanism_or_method: Imaging and regulating three discharge domains and building a cask model bridging cascaded-capacitor-breakdown dynamics and real output.
limitation: Specific device configurations; generality across materials and long-term operation not established.

object: MgB2-PVA conductive nanocomposite hydrogel
problem: How to make conductive hydrogels both strong and highly sensitive for soft sensing?
mechanism_or_method: Self-assembly-induced bridge cross-linking of MgB2 nanosheets with PVA giving hierarchical lamellar structure and B-O-C bonds.
limitation: Lab tests only; long-term stability against dehydration and nanosheet degradation not discussed.

object: [c2]daisy chain shape-memory polymer networks
problem: Does a mechanically interlocked daisy chain topology drive shape-memory function in polymer networks?
mechanism_or_method: Embed crown-ether [c2]daisy chain crosslinks and compare against control groups to isolate the interlocked topology effect.
limitation: Complex synthesis of the daisy chain monomer; single polymer system.

object: dynamic porous crystal for propylene/propane separation
problem: Can diffusion-rate sieving at 300 K give high-purity propylene from propylene/propane mixtures?
mechanism_or_method: Cooperative global gate opening for C3H6 and local diffusion regulation for C3H8 in a dynamic porous coordination polymer.
limitation: Laboratory breakthrough tests of equimolar mixtures; cycling and humidity stability not shown.

object: ultrasound-actuated untethered soft robots
problem: How to achieve selective, Newton-level force actuation of miniature untethered soft robots?
mechanism_or_method: Focused ultrasound heating triggers internal phase transition and inflation, with ultrasound imaging for automatic acoustic alignment.
limitation: Tested in phantoms and tissue models; heating safety and depth limits in vivo unresolved.

object: liquid metal droplet elastomer infrared-modulating films
problem: Can chameleon-inspired liquid metal films tune infrared reflection in multiple modes?
mechanism_or_method: Shape-morphing liquid metal droplets in Ecoflex deform under strain, changing total and specular reflectance; multilayer with metal film.
limitation: Lab-scale films; cycling durability and real thermal camouflage field performance not shown.

object: Cu(II)-coordinated chelating ion exchanger for direct air capture
problem: Can a polyamine-Cu(II) hybrid sorbent greatly increase CO2 capture capacity from ultradilute air?
mechanism_or_method: Lewis acid-base interaction sorbent with thermal or seawater regeneration that sequesters released CO2 as bicarbonate.
limitation: Lab sorption tests; ocean sequestration scale and environmental impact not evaluated.

object: US electric vehicle battery supply chain
problem: Would reshoring EV battery manufacturing reduce carbon footprint and energy use under evolving technologies?
mechanism_or_method: Life-cycle and supply chain scenario analysis of reshoring and ally-shoring across battery chemistries and nickel sources.
limitation: Depends on projected market and battery technology scenarios with high uncertainty.

object: bioinspired cage-trap lead management for perovskite solar cells
problem: Can an amino-grafted carbon net capture lead leakage and support closed-loop lead recycling?
mechanism_or_method: Mesoporous amino-grafted carbon net integrated in cells chelates and adsorbs Pb; contamination assessed in river water and soil.
limitation: Lab-scale cells and simulated contamination; long-term field leakage not measured.

object: rocksalt high-entropy oxide with Mn(II) and Fe(II)
problem: Can a rocksalt high-entropy oxide containing divalent Mn and Fe be synthesized and what is its structure and magnetism?
mechanism_or_method: Bottom-up synthesis with structural, valence and spin characterization, plus phase stability prediction.
limitation: Single composition; stability conditions are predictive and mostly unverified across compositions.

object: potassium-modified edge-rich MoS2 catalyst
problem: How to achieve selective CO hydrogenation to higher alcohols by controlling C-O cleavage and C-C coupling?
mechanism_or_method: Edge-rich MoS2 sulfur vacancies promote chain growth while potassium aids alcohol desorption.
limitation: CO conversion only 17% with 45% selectivity; long-term stability not shown.
